about.hero.lede: Founded in October 2003 by Dr. Morjina Akhter — dignified, confidential anorectal care for women and men.
about.story.title: One goal since 2003
about.story.p1: Dhaka Piles Care Center was founded in October 2003 by Dr. Morjina Akhter, with a single purpose: that every patient — woman or man — with an anorectal condition receives care in a dignified, confidential setting.
about.story.p2: The clinic was previously known as Baridhara Piles Cure Center; its present name is Dhaka Piles Care Center.
about.story.p3: Patients come to this North Baridhara chamber from all eight divisions of Bangladesh — Dhaka, Chattogram, Rajshahi, Khulna, Barishal, Sylhet, Rangpur and Mymensingh.
about.story.note: Note: the Google Maps listing may still show the clinic's former name (Baridhara Piles Cure Center) — the current name is Dhaka Piles Care Center.

about.mv.title: How we work
about.mv.lede: Three principles have guided the clinic since 2003.
about.mv.1.d: Every patient — woman or man — is heard with dignity; consultation, examination and treatment stay confidential.
about.mv.2.d: No miracle claims — a realistic treatment path is explained according to the examination findings, and what will happen is explained beforehand.
about.mv.3.d: Decisions come after understanding — the clinic's health-education posts exist so that patients are not driven to buying medicines on their own.
about.mv.note: These principles are reflected in the clinic's health-education posts and in the way patients are treated every day.
